notes: Paper presents 95% C.L. projected constraints from mock IPTA and future PTA data on five scalar ULDM couplings (d_hat_m, d_e, d_mu, d_gamma, d_g) in the Damour-Donoghue parameterization, over mass range 1e-24 to 1e-20 eV. These span multiple enum categories: d_gamma->ScalarPhoton (alpha variation), d_e->ScalarElectron, d_g->ScalarNucleon/gluon, d_hat_m->quark mass. Coupling type is ambiguous since multiple couplings are constrained; ScalarPhoton chosen as representative but confidence kept low. Data only available in Fig. 1 plots, not in tables; no numerical values extractable. Local DM density rho=0.4 GeV/cm^3.
